blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution has asked a trial chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) to dismiss a request filed by the defense team of former President Rodrigo Duterte on a redacted matter, citing its supposed violation of the court’s established rules. The public redacted version of the prosecution’s response to the defense was dated Nov. 13 but released only on Nov. 20. The request was panned by Acting Prosecutor Mame Mandiaye Niang and was submitted to Trial Chamber (TC) III judges Joanna Korner, Keebong Paek, and Nicolas Guillou.
